title: Russian Strikes Hit Key Power Plant in Kyiv; Zelensky Condemns Allied Warning Gap
detail: Russia struck a key power plant in Kyiv in an overnight attack. President Zelensky condemned the strike and said allied partners gave no advance warning before the assault — continuing a pattern he flagged after two consecutive nights of barrages with no intelligence sharing from Western partners.

title: Trump Vows to Broker Peace Deal Between Zelensky and Putin
detail: US President Trump vowed to broker a peace deal between Ukrainian President Zelensky and Russian President Putin as diplomatic pressure on both sides intensifies. The announcement came amid ongoing Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and continued uncertainty about a broader ceasefire framework.

title: Italian PM Meloni Condemns Trump's 'Very Risky' Putin Deal; Zelensky Meets UK's Andy Burnham
detail: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni publicly criticized US President Trump's approach to a potential deal with Putin, calling it 'very risky.' Separately, Ukrainian President Zelensky met with UK Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham amid ongoing peace negotiations, underscoring continued European engagement with Ukrainian leadership outside formal diplomatic channels.

title: Zelensky Visits UK to Press Allies on Intelligence Sharing After Russian Strikes
detail: Ukrainian President Zelensky visited the UK to press allies on improving intelligence sharing after recent Russian strikes caught Ukraine off-guard. The visit follows Zelensky's public criticism of Western partners for failing to provide advance warning before consecutive nights of Russian missile and drone barrages on Ukrainian infrastructure.

title: Russian Missile and Drone Barrage Kills 3 Civilians, Leaves 600,000 Without Power; Starlink Restricted
detail: A Russian missile and drone barrage killed at least 3 civilians and left approximately 600,000 people without electricity across Ukraine. The attack occurred amid ongoing ceasefire-adjacent claims from both sides. Separately, Starlink satellite internet access was reported restricted for frontline combat operations, limiting Ukrainian battlefield communications.

media.caption: Russian missile and drone barrage kills 3 civilians and leaves 600,000 without power in Ukraine
